correctness.rationale: Path stable-set facets are precisely x_i>=0 and x_i+x_(i+1)<=1. The primitive facet matrix becomes a rooted-graph incidence matrix after row sign changes, proving total unimodularity and smoothness of every simplicial cone. Its graphic circuits are root-to-root paths; feasibility forces even-length alternating 0,1,0, giving exactly the n-2 minimal nonsimplicial rank-three cones. Their dual Hilbert bases give uv-wz, and their orbit closures form the claimed component products. Face intersection is nonempty exactly for independent center sets. Standard-library rational-rank checker exhaustively corroborates n=3,...,7; the proof covers all n>=3 and all characteristics.

originality.rationale: The primary articles by Hibi et al. (2015) and Matsuda et al. (2016) define and study chain and stable-set polytopes, but their inspected theorem statements and sections address lattice equivalence, volumes, normality and toric ideals, not the complete normal-fan singular locus or its incidence nerve. The affine Hibi singular-locus theorem of Lakshmibai--Mukherjee does not apply to this different projective normal-fan construction. Targeted full-claim searches of a mathematical record index found no equivalent singular-locus theorem. Originality is qualified by incomplete global indexing and possible equivalent formulations.

A complete exact decomposition into n-2 codimension-three conifold strata with explicit component products and path-independence incidence nerve is structural geometric information beyond compressed-polytope/normality properties or finite counts.
